## Validation Checklist

- [ ] Ran `bd ready --json` before starting work.
- [ ] Claimed or created Beads work for non-trivial changes, or explained why it was not applicable.
- [ ] Added focused unit tests for every functional change.
- [ ] Ran the full unit-test suite.
- [ ] Ran lint checks.
- [ ] Validated the changes with the deterministic backtest.

## Notes

Describe any intentionally skipped check and why it was not applicable.
